question: Can AI label type and sentiment?
setup: 3 Haiku coders, Sonnet on disputes, 12,500 mentions
result: Kappa 0.77-0.79 type, 0.71-0.73 sentiment. No human gold standard

question: Which column groups matter?
setup: Boosting on cumulative groups, against median and constant × followers
result: Constant 0.92 / 0.86 / 0.88; with reactions 0.29 / 0.46 / 0.50

question: Do intervals hold? Does a model transfer?
setup: Split conformal; ridge and boosting on likes + comments, leave one platform out
result: 90% coverage 0.89-0.90, width ×16 / ×104 / ×133 in total; transfer 0.31 / 0.61 / 0.65

question: Do other models or first graph features help?
setup: 6 families + blend on fixed settings; author and text-neighbour features; strata
result: Best 0.28 / 0.45 / 0.48. Graph at most about 0.009. Models per follower tier worse

question: Labels vs views
setup: Residual after reactions, by type
result: Moves views at most about 0.1; only TikTok promo clearly above zero (+0.08)

question: Do extra columns help?
setup: Extra trees; text stats, VADER, TF-IDF, calendar, ratios, brand size
result: Text +0.011-0.016 on YouTube and X; the rest about zero

question: Brand graph, predicting reactions
setup: Brand similarity graph; targets from other columns
result: Brand graph small on X only; reactions predictable (R² up to 0.76), followers less

question: Graph lab
setup: Louvain, PageRank, spectral, author-brand, hashtags, time, duplicates, encodings
result: At most about 0.007; label propagation worse (X -0.021)

question: What does the text graph find?
setup: Homophily, duplicates, type from text
result: Duplicates 6-14% of posts; on X 38% spam against 9%; pair view correlation 0.66-0.82

question: Do reactions transfer to FB/IG? Two-stage reactions then views
setup: Followers + text to reactions across 5 platforms
result: Spearman 0.3-0.47 inside a platform; two-stage no gain

question: Default model vs baselines
setup: scikit-learn boosting with defaults
result: With reactions 0.29 / 0.53 / 0.49

question: Does tuning change the ranking?
setup: 10 families, nested search, 40 settings per fold
result: Best 0.27 (SVR) / 0.45 / 0.47 (CatBoost); ridge 0.55 on YouTube

question: Tuned boosters with text
setup: CatBoost, LightGBM + text stats and TF-IDF
result: At most +0.013

question: Full transfer matrix
setup: 6 models, 3 column sets, 12 pairings, test brands removed
result: Ridge on likes + comments best: 0.31 / 0.61 / 0.65, bias +0.03 / +0.21 / -0.40; order kept

question: Tuning for transfer, label correction
setup: Across-source tuning; reweighting; type as a feature
result: No consistent gain

question: Calibration with few posts
setup: Shift by median error of n target posts
result: On X 25-50 posts bring 0.65 to about 0.55; ideal 0.54. Not checked on FB/IG

question: FB/IG sensitivity to source
setup: Median estimate per source set
result: Spread ×1.7 and ×2.4. Not a measured error

question: Three-way ablation with labels
setup: Alone, added, removed; second learner
result: Removing likes +0.09 / +0.13 / +0.05; labels at most +0.005

question: Systematic errors
setup: Signed error by subgroup
result: Lowest fifth overestimated 0.23 / 0.51 / 0.67, top fifth underestimated 0.20 / 0.42 / 0.56

question: Promo vs views per reaction
setup: Line per type
result: Promo ×1.5-1.9 at equal likes and comments on TikTok and YouTube

question: Dropping spam from training
setup: Extra trees
result: At most 0.002

question: Community detection
setup: Louvain on text kNN, no views or labels

question: False brand matches
setup: Keyword check of one community
result: Cricket Wireless 0 of 20 about the company. One example; frequency unknown

question: YouTube transcripts
setup: Flag for mentions starting with a time stamp
result: 21% of mentions; flag +0.008

question: Brand24 rule
setup: Reconstruct from data
result: Reproduces 98% / 96% / 98% of X, FB, IG; unconfirmed. Real views per reaction 21 / 20 / 27; rule on X 700

question: Rule vs model on X
setup: Same rows
result: Rule 1.08, simple rule with learned constants 0.68, extra trees 0.47

question: One is-promo column
setup: 3 learners, 2 column sets
result: At most +0.006 with followers and reactions; up to +0.012 on likes + comments

question: Is promo behind YouTube errors?
setup: Error by reaction state and promo share
result: Mostly no. Zero likes and comments: 23% of posts, 35% of error. Possible missing data, unconfirmed

question: Removing zero-reaction posts
setup: From test, and from training
result: Test 0.27 / 0.38 / 0.45 because it is easier; training gain at most 0.002

question: Second graph round
setup: Fixed aggregation, cross-platform neighbours, community shrinkage
result: Only cross-platform on YouTube +0.009; a hint given many tests. Slopes differ by community on TikTok and YouTube

question: Graph bridge across platforms
setup: Neighbours from other platforms, leave one out
result: Level shift unchanged; ridge on zero-reaction posts only +0.018-0.022

question: Two-stage models
setup: Tier classifier, routing, residuals, hurdle, promo, community
result: No clear gain; residual stacking worse

question: MAE loss
setup: Default CatBoost, RMSE to MAE

question: Error by reaction tier
setup: CatBoost MAE; ridge out of platform
result: YouTube ×4.6 to ×1.8; X ×3.1 to ×2.5; TikTok flat after the first reaction

question: Interval per reaction tier
setup: Mondrian conformal
result: One width covers 67-87% at zero reactions; per tier about 90%, except TikTok at zero

question: False match seen in the text graph
setup: TikTok TF-IDF 10-NN graph, Louvain; Cricket Wireless against six mobile-network brands
result: All 20 Cricket Wireless mentions in one group with cricket posts (Aon); 4 edges to the 28 mobile-network posts

question: Brand industry labels
setup: Haiku agent, general knowledge, 348 brands
result: 20 industries; 83 names flagged as having another meaning; 2 low confidence

question: Brand away from its industry in the text graph
setup: Share of other-brand neighbours from the same industry vs chance, 5 platforms
result: Lowest include Frontier (X, AI), Gap (YouTube, AI), Guardian Life (Minecraft), Wrangler (Jeep); some are other languages; Cricket Wireless not low (lift 1.4 on TikTok); AUC vs name flag 0.62 (0.55-0.69)

question: What is in the second Brand24 file?
setup: `reach_samples_students_with_history.csv`: same 12,500 mentions, 23 new columns
result: History (up to 3 earlier checks) only on TikTok 341 and X 349 posts, almost all from 2026-08; latest check (`current_*`) for 1,230 posts incl. 512 YouTube. Old 19 columns unchanged; views never fall between checks; history and current times are Polish local time (+2 h), converted to UTC

question: How fast do views grow?
setup: Power law views ~ age^b between first and last check, brand bootstrap
result: b 0.35 (0.29-0.39) / 0.58 (0.50-0.66) / 1.17 (0.76-1.93); median growth ×1.3 / ×1.2 / ×2.4 from 30 h / 102 h / 7.5 h to 222 h / 706 h / 14 h. X checks in this subset cover only the first day

question: Forecast later views from the first check
setup: CatBoost (MAE loss) on growth with first-check views, reactions, ages; against persistence and power law

question: Forecast without views at the first check
setup: Same CatBoost, first-check reactions + followers + ages only
result: 0.368 / 0.444 / 0.544; the early view count is worth 0.20-0.28 of MAE

question: Interval of the forecast
setup: Leave-brand-out residual quantile, 90%

question: Estimate at posting time (no reactions)
setup: CatBoost on followers, text stats, VADER, TF-IDF SVD, AI labels, calendar, horizon, brand size; + author history from training fold
result: 0.575 / 0.684 / 0.550 against constant × followers 0.912 / 0.860 / 0.880 and followers-only CatBoost 0.591 / 0.775 / 0.584; author history +0.001 / -0.002 / +0.004 (CI includes zero); 90% interval ×20 / ×27 / ×14; with reactions 0.27 / 0.45 / 0.45

question: Does the age of the view check help the final model?
setup: Final CatBoost (MAE loss, followers + reactions + flags) + log10 hours from posting to the check; error by age of the check

question: Are the newer checks more predictable?
setup: Views, reactions and age replaced by the latest check (`current_*`) for 348 / 503 / 342 posts; same model, folds and posts
result: On the refreshed posts -0.010 (-0.017 to -0.002) / +0.006 (-0.011-0.020) / -0.046 (-0.066 to -0.027): not better, worse on X, where views grew in 10% of these posts while reactions changed in 1%

question: Rolling window: does the final model hold up when trained only on earlier months?
setup: Final model trained on all months before M, tested on M = 2026-05 … 08 (1,949 / 2,000 / 1,685 posts); against brand CV on the same posts; also without the test month's brands, and previous month only
result: Expanding window vs brand CV -0.001 (-0.004-0.002) / -0.011 (-0.018 to -0.004) / -0.026 (-0.036 to -0.017); most of the gap is May (X 0.552 vs 0.480), from June on within 0.02. Unseen brands cost ≤ 0.005 more; previous month only is worse (-0.013 / -0.023 / -0.032). No drift in error; YouTube views per like fell in Jul-Aug without raising the error

question: Do tabular foundation models (TabPFN v2, TabICL) beat or add to the final model?
setup: TabPFN v2 regressor (median output) and TabICL v2, 8 estimators, seeds 0/1/2, same ENG features and brand folds as the final CatBoost (2,491 / 2,441 / 1,803 posts); plain means; CPU, 2-4 min per model and platform
result: TabPFN vs CatBoost +0.005 (0.003-0.008) / +0.010 (0.004-0.017) / +0.002 (-0.003-0.007); mean of all three +0.004 (0.002-0.006) / +0.010 (0.006-0.014) / +0.003 (-0.000-0.006). YouTube gain is not only zero-reaction posts (+0.009 with reactions); TikTok gain sits in posts with > 1,000 reactions (+0.026). Small

question: Classification: viral top 10%, and posts without a view count
setup: Top 10% of views per platform on held-out brands: followers, Brand24 reach (X only; equals views on TikTok/YouTube), final regression, CatBoost classifier. Missing/zero views (9 / 59 / 697 posts) vs present: classifier on date, age at check, reactions
result: Regression ranks viral posts as well as a classifier: AUC 0.983 / 0.935 / 0.894, precision in top 10% 83% / 71% / 63% vs followers 36% / 44% / 43%. On X, 2025 posts almost never have views (12 of 170); missing/zero is predictable (AUC 0.95 YouTube, 0.91 X): a collection artefact. Zero-view posts get 9-15 predicted views on YouTube and X

question: Context from other posts of the same author, hashtag and brand (no view counts used)
setup: Leave-self-out features from all 12,500 mentions: author, hashtags, brand on platform and other platforms, text copies; added to the final model, and to a followers-only model
result: Next to reactions nothing ≥ 0.01; brand context worse on YouTube (-0.014, CI -0.019 to -0.008); author +0.003 (CI incl. 0). Without reactions all context +0.007 / +0.054 / +0.009

question: Text: local sentence embeddings (multilingual-e5-small) and TF-IDF
setup: PCA 16 of embeddings and TF-IDF SVD 16, unsupervised; added to the final model and to followers only
result: With reactions: embeddings +0.003 / -0.009 / +0.011 (X CI 0.002-0.020); TF-IDF about 0. Without reactions: embeddings +0.009 / +0.051 / +0.018, TF-IDF +0.005 / +0.051 / +0.010

question: Offset target: learn views per like
setup: CatBoost on log10(views) - log10(likes+1), offset added back; same features and folds
result: +0.001 / +0.007 (0.003-0.010) / +0.000; bias of extreme fifths narrows only 0.01-0.03. Compression is regression to the mean, not tree extrapolation

question: Posting-time estimate with sentence embeddings and context from other posts
setup: E43 posting-time columns + e5 embeddings (PCA 16), TF-IDF replaced by embeddings, + E49 context without own likes, + both; same folds
result: Context +0.004 / +0.020 (0.011-0.027) / +0.008; embeddings ≤ +0.009; both +0.008 / +0.017 / +0.010. Best posting-time MAE 0.566 / 0.664 / 0.540. Context uses later posts too: upper bound

question: Fine-tuned transformer: the row as text, and text as a correction
setup: multilingual-e5-small fine-tuned on CPU (3.4 h), one joint model, joint brand folds; row as text → log views; text → CatBoost residual (inner out-of-fold)
result: Row as text alone -0.018 / -0.001 / -0.023; mean with CatBoost +0.019 (0.012-0.027) on YouTube; CatBoost + half correction +0.007 / +0.012 / +0.008, all CIs above zero

question: Stack of every model family on the same folds
setup: 8 members (CatBoost variants, TabPFN v2, TabICL, MLP, fine-tuned text) out of fold on joint brand folds; convex MAE weights fitted by nested brand CV
result: Stack 0.260 / 0.425 / 0.441: +0.011 / +0.028 / +0.026 over the final model, +0.008 / +0.018 / +0.012 over the best single member, all CIs above zero; plain mean of all gives most of it

question: Leakage audit: folds that also separate authors and copied texts
setup: Final model on brand folds, brand ∪ author ∪ identical-text components, and random folds
result: Strict folds +0.002 / -0.001 / -0.011 (X CI -0.020 to -0.003); random folds +0.003 / +0.009 / -0.002. Headline holds; X slightly optimistic (0.47 → 0.48); seen brands help little

question: Noise ceiling: posts with almost the same inputs
setup: Pairs of different-brand posts with all four log inputs within 0.05; best MAE ≥ ½ mean abs(delta)
result: Lower bound 0.223 / 0.388 / 0.333 vs final model 0.325 / 0.578 / 0.471 on the same posts; near-identical posts differ ×2.8 / ×6.0 / ×4.6 in views

question: Quantile models and tail weighting
setup: CatBoost MultiQuantile 10/50/90%; final model with weight 2 on the outer fifths
result: 10-90% covers 73-74% (top fifth 44-54%); median ×5.4 / ×14.1 / ×28.9; q50 +0.007 on YouTube; tail weighting ≤ 0.002, extremes unchanged

question: Abstention: error on the posts kept
setup: Final model errors ranked by quantile width, tier width, random, oracle
result: Keeping the 50% narrowest: -10% / -27% / -6% MAE (0.246 / 0.334 / 0.439); quantile width slightly better than tier width

question: Forecast horizon curve; training on every pair of checks
setup: E40 CatBoost on growth, first-last pairs vs all 3,218 pairs; error by gap and by age of the first check
result: All pairs -0.020 / 0.000 / +0.008 (worse on TikTok). TikTok error grows with the gap (0.10 < 12 h → 0.18 at 7-30 d); a first check < 12 h is 2-4× harder (0.23 / 0.43 / 0.28)

question: Early-reaction forecast without views (FB/IG setting)
setup: TikTok / X: later likes from early likes; chain forecast reactions → now-cast model; vs E41
result: Likes +0.068 over persistence on TikTok, none on X. Chain beats E41: +0.034 (0.012-0.058) TikTok, +0.033 (-0.010-0.077) X; upper bound with true later reactions +0.076 / +0.110

question: One pooled model for three platforms, monotone constraints
setup: Joint brand folds; per platform vs pooled (platform category), ± monotone on followers and reactions; LOPO CatBoost vs ridge

question: Why YouTube views per like fell in Jul-Aug
setup: Median age at check, views per like and monthly bias, ± age column
result: Age at check fell from 78-100 days (Apr-May) to 0.6-8 days (Aug) on all platforms; YouTube views per like fell 1.57 → 1.13, TikTok/X flat; age column does not remove the monthly bias

question: Copy-paste campaigns
setup: Same normalised text elsewhere in the data; views per like, reach share, model error
result: Copies 1-6% of posts; more views per like (1.62 vs 1.38 TikTok); model 2× worse on them and underestimates YouTube copies by 0.26; 6 YouTube and 7 X brands get > 50% of reach from copies

question: Separate model for posts without likes and comments
setup: YouTube 665 / X 991 such posts; final model vs all-post model + text and context vs zero-only model
result: All-post + text and context +0.030 (0.016-0.045) on X, -0.005 on YouTube; zero-only model no gain

question: GraphSAGE on the text-similarity graph
setup: 10-NN e5 graph per platform, 2-layer GraphSAGE vs same MLP without graph vs CatBoost; means with CatBoost; ENG + embedding PCA 16
result: GraphSAGE vs MLP -0.006 / -0.011 / -0.006: the graph hurts. Control: mean CatBoost + MLP +0.008 / +0.016 / +0.016 (CIs above 0), same as with GraphSAGE: an ensemble effect, not a graph effect

question: Account type from the author name
setup: Official brand account / brand in the name / news-media / other, built locally from author vs brand name; follower tiers; label as a feature
result: Official accounts ≤ 5% of posts, fewer views per follower (TikTok 0.06 vs 0.60) but underestimated by 0.36 / 0.52 (TikTok / YouTube); as a feature ±0.001

question: Topic clusters of all posts
setup: k-means (16) on e5 embeddings of 12,500 posts, class-based TF-IDF words; final-model bias per cluster
result: Clusters = industries, events, hiring, complaints, languages; NMI with brand 0.30; bias within ±0.1 except luxury resale -0.24

question: Author over-performance persists
setup: Views above the final model's prediction, first vs later posts of an author; correction from the author's earlier posts
result: Spearman 0.68 / 0.69 / 0.70 (0.66-0.70 without repeats); top vs bottom third ×4-9; correction gains +0.116 / +0.157 / +0.098 MAE on posts with an earlier post (3-16% of posts), all CIs above zero

question: Brand communities and cold start
setup: Brand graph from shared authors + text similarity, Louvain; similar brands' over-performance vs a brand's own
result: 9 industry communities, modularity 0.50; cold start rho 0.27 / 0.02 / 0.12, only TikTok CI above zero

question: Author history in depth, and at posting time
setup: Corrections from the author's earlier posts (mean, last post, shrunk sum); same on the posting-time model
result: Shrunk sum best: +0.116 / +0.149 / +0.102 with reactions, +0.169 / +0.141 / +0.148 at posting time, all CIs above zero; one earlier post gives most of it

question: Can the author's level be predicted without history?
setup: CatBoost on account traits (followers, kind, language, zero-reaction share) → author's mean over-performance
result: Spearman -0.05 / -0.03 / -0.12 against split-half 0.70 / 0.71 / 0.68: hidden, only history reveals it

question: Variance components of the error
setup: Pairwise intraclass correlation of the final model's error: same author, same brand (other authors)
result: Author 0.74 / 0.63 / 0.12 (X dominated by prolific authors), brand 0.06 / 0.03 / 0.08

question: Brand totals
setup: Error of a brand's summed views (≥ 5 posts), calibrated on other folds; Brand24 reach on X
result: Total MAE 0.227 / 0.311 / 0.317 vs per post 0.273 / 0.456 / 0.466; Spearman 0.93 / 0.86 / 0.82; Brand24 reach on X 1.017 (×10 too high)

question: Anomalies ×10 above or below the prediction
setup: Traits of posts with error ≥ 1 in log10; flag from the author's history
result: ×10 above (1-6%): more promo (TikTok), copies, brand accounts, repeat authors; ×10 below: zero reactions, spam; history raises P(×10 above) 6-15×

question: Views per like implied by the final model
setup: Median 10^prediction / likes and elasticity by follower × like tier
result: TikTok 50 → 11 as likes grow; YouTube 17-47 (more for > 1M); X 25-112 vs Brand24's 700; doubling reactions ×1.3-2.3 views

question: Where the remaining error sits
setup: Share of error by reply, link, zero reactions, author activity, follower tier; traits as columns
result: Error spread over all posts; 10 most active X authors 5% of error; zero-reaction posts worst; traits +0.001 / +0.006 / +0.011 (YouTube, X CIs above zero)

question: How many earlier author posts are needed
setup: Shrunk sum of the last k earlier posts, k = 1-10
result: k = 1: +0.10 / +0.14 / +0.07 (X CI crosses zero); YouTube k = 2-3 about +0.17; too few posts for k ≥ 5

question: Author level without views
setup: Reactions on the author's other posts in the sample as columns
result: No gain: -0.002 / 0.000 / 0.000; on posts with other posts -0.047 / +0.016 / -0.002

question: Live forecast plus author history
setup: E40 forecast + shrunk author residuals
result: Only 31 YouTube pairs; +0.005 (CI crosses zero); inconclusive

question: Intervals for brand totals
setup: Brand-level quantiles vs summed independent post errors
result: Brand-level 80% interval calibrated (0.79-0.80), ×2.2 / ×3.0 / ×3.3; independent errors not calibrated

question: FB / IG next to platforms with views
setup: Reaction structure; adversarial AUC target vs source
result: IG closest to X / YouTube (AUC 0.65), not TikTok (0.85); FB far from all (0.81-0.87, with followers 0.89-0.98)

question: Pre-registered FB / IG estimates
setup: Transfer models on the 312 hand-check posts before any view is seen; scoring ready
result: FB about 200-250 views, IG 35-95; Brand24 reach ×15-20 above ours on FB, below on IG; awaiting hand check

question: Residual atlas
setup: Over-performance by country, hour, sentiment, type, text style

question: Country, local time, holidays, industry as columns
setup: One-hot country, local hour / weekend / holiday, E69 community, type label
result: Country +0.005 TikTok only; type label +0.004-0.005; local time and industry 0 or worse

question: Where promo over-performs
setup: Promo − organic over-performance by follower, reaction tier, country, industry
result: Only with reactions or mid-sized accounts: TikTok 10k-100k +0.18, YouTube 11+ reactions +0.13-0.20, X 1k-100k +0.20; tiny accounts / no reactions negative, so the average cancels

question: Brand popularity on Wikipedia
setup: Monthly English Wikipedia pageviews of the brand (293 hand-checked brands, only brand names sent) as columns
result: Spearman with brand mean views 0.05-0.18; columns 0.000 / -0.010 / -0.010 (YouTube, X CIs below zero)

question: Mapping reaction scales between platforms
setup: Leave one platform out; z-score, quantile matching, ratios of reactions; + shift on n posts
result: Raw inputs best: 0.31 / 0.60 / 0.64; quantile / z-score 0.61-1.43; with 25-50 calibration posts mapped CatBoost +0.03 on X only

question: Adapting the out-of-platform model to the target's reaction structure
setup: Importance weights, per-source mixture, views per like, raw + structure; no target views
result: Only X gains: weighted ridge +0.023, CatBoost +0.032; TikTok worse (-0.07 to -0.17); YouTube ±0.04; FB / IG estimates pre-registered

question: Few-shot recalibration with k target posts
setup: Median / shrunk (EB) shift, slope shrunk to 1, biased ridge; few-shot conformal
result: k = 5: EB shift 0.315 / 0.626 / 0.588 vs median 0.347 / 0.679 / 0.621; from k = 25 slope or biased ridge best on X (0.525-0.550); conformal covers 0.87-0.92 from k = 10

question: Anchor regression, group DRO, stabilised weights
setup: No target labels
result: None beats ridge everywhere (±0.01); group DRO 0.721 on YouTube; flattened weights lose the X gain

question: Input subset by source-to-source transfer
setup: 63 subsets, choose on the two sources
result: Fails on TikTok (0.497 vs 0.312); likes + comments stays the safe choice

question: Brand effect carried over from other platforms
setup: Shrunk brand residual from source platforms

question: How wrong is the transfer to Facebook, measured?
setup: Ridge on likes + comments trained on X + YouTube, scored on 130 FB Reels/videos with fetched views

question: Do followers improve the measured transfer to Facebook?
setup: Ridge on likes + comments + log10(followers) and a missing flag, trained on X + YouTube, scored on the 130 FB posts
result: Worse: 0.345 -> 0.627 (gain -0.283, CI -0.361 to -0.209); 88 posts with followers 0.360 -> 0.437; followers alone 1.199

question: Does the FB transfer hold beyond the hand-check sample?
setup: E93 ridge scored on all 402 public FB Reels/videos, by kind and age

question: How concentrated is reach?
setup: Share of views in the top 1/5/10%, Gini, Hill tail, brands with >= 5 posts
result: Top 1% of posts = 60-74% of views, top 5% = 82-90%, Gini 0.92-0.96; 2-4% of posts give 80%; 56% of brands one post > 50%

question: Which FB posts to hand-check with a budget of k?
setup: Random vs reaction-stratified vs extremes vs brand-diverse vs leverage, median-shift calibration
result: Reaction stratification = random; extremes best at k=50 (0.321 vs 0.346 on 130, 0.377 vs 0.385 on 402); leverage best at k=5

question: Intervals for the FB estimate
setup: Source-residual width vs split conformal on k FB posts, 402 posts
result: Source widths over-cover (80% -> 0.925, 90% -> 0.960); FB conformal k=50: 0.790 / 0.880

question: Where does Brand24's reach rule fail?
setup: Error of `b24_estimated_reach` vs measured views, by platform and, on X, by follower/reaction tier and age
result: Exact on TikTok/YouTube (MAE 0); X median x9.3, MAE 1.08, 87% off >2x; worst 1-10 reactions x27 and mid accounts x16

question: Does text help the Facebook transfer?
setup: e5 embeddings (PCA 16) added to likes + comments, trained on X + YouTube, scored on 130 and 402 FB posts

question: Do views need age normalisation?
setup: Views normalised to 30 days with a per-platform growth exponent, predictions converted back; LOPO and FB
result: MAE changes <=0.01 (FB 0.385 -> 0.380) but the FB bias drops from +0.14 to 0.00

question: Brand scorecard: ranking vs level
setup: Brand totals (>=5 posts) and top-10% alerts: Brand24 reach vs ridge on likes + comments vs views
result: On TikTok/YouTube the reach is the view count (perfect by construction); on X Kendall 0.63 vs 0.58 and alert precision 0.61 vs 0.58, though the level is x9.3 off

question: Are the same texts posted across platforms?
setup: Normalised title + content, texts > 30 chars, count on >= 2 platforms
result: 1 of 12 065 texts (0.008%); no platform multiplier from repeated content

question: Viral alert at the top 1%
setup: CatBoost classifier on likes + comments vs raw likes vs Brand24 reach, brand CV, precision at k
result: Model AUC 0.99/0.84/0.85 but precision 0.56/0.48/0.26; raw likes 0.64/0.64/0.47; the MAE model compresses the tail

question: Is the X view count missing at random?
setup: Selection model on reactions, followers, age; IPW reweighting of the observed mean
result: Missing 25.4%, mostly 2025 (66.5% vs 22.4%), older checks (66 vs 22 days), smaller accounts; selection AUC 0.837; observed mean reach 435 vs 332 full sample (~1.3x)

question: Alert budget: recall at k alerts for the top 1%
setup: Model, raw likes, Brand24 reach; recall at 10-200 alerts and alerts for 50% recall
result: X: 117 alerts (model) vs 22 (likes) vs 25 (Brand24) for 50% recall; TikTok 20/16/13; YouTube 26/17/13 (Brand24 is the view count there)

question: Brand portfolio: what would change on X?
setup: Brand totals (>=5 posts), rule vs ridge vs views; ratio, off-2x share, Kendall
result: X: rule x11.2, 96% of 189 brands off >2x, median error 1.05; model x0.66, 49% off, 0.30; Kendall 0.63 vs 0.58. TikTok/YouTube: rule exact

question: Confidence flags from metadata
setup: CatBoost on missing flags, age, followers, platform, reach; predict abs(error) > 0.5; flag top 20-50%

question: Calibrated brand totals with intervals on X

question: Does posting cadence reduce reach per post?

question: Brand24's FB reach against measured views

question: Recency, sequence and text-surface columns

question: Distributional model vs CQR

question: Can the >1M FB tier be calibrated?

question: FB band excluding the largest pages

question: Hybrid FB model

question: FB error by industry

question: FB brand totals and hybrid ranking

question: FB brand totals after calibration

question: Robustness to missing followers

question: Which signal does the FB transfer use?

result: Followers only 1.342; reactions 0.385; both 0.660 (0.343 on >1M, 0.727 below)

question: Which model when data is missing?

result: Specialised wins everywhere: no reactions 0.583/0.767/0.575 (full 1.139/1.462/0.609); no followers 0.276/0.494/0.515 (full 0.294/0.711/0.733)

question: Partial missingness crossover
setup: 0-100% missing reactions/followers, full vs specialised model
result: Switch at ~35% missing reactions (TikTok/YouTube), ~70% (X); ~20% missing followers (YouTube/X); TikTok reactions-only equal at 0%

question: FB rule vs model by follower tier
setup: MAE of the rule and the reaction model per tier
result: Rule 0.958-1.012 in every tier; model 0.364-0.463; model wins everywhere

question: FB intervals on the 130 hand posts
setup: CQR calibrated on 25% of the hand-sample brands, 20 splits
result: Coverage 0.898, width 1.59 (402 posts: 0.925 / 1.99)

question: How much do views depend on followers vs reactions per platform?
setup: Per-platform OLS on log10 views with log followers and log reactions; brand-grouped OOF R2; brand bootstrap
result: Follower elasticity 0.044/0.303/0.164; reaction elasticity 0.82/0.66/1.06; R2 0.81/0.59/0.47; 43%/5%/14% of posts beat followers

question: How much of Brand24's reach rule can be recovered?
setup: max(k*reactions, c(followers)*followers) fitted per bin; share of rows within 1%
result: IG 97%, X 62%, FB 49%; TikTok 1.2%, YouTube 1.0% (reach is views there)

question: Can brand history substitute for unknown author history?

result: Brand prior hurts: TikTok -0.005, YouTube -0.035, X +0.006 (CI includes 0); known-brand share 52/48/35%

question: Brand news attention on Wikipedia at post time
setup: Daily pageviews of 293 brand articles; post day / 7-day mean / peak vs 60-day baseline as columns; final CatBoost + FB transfer

question: Company facts from Wikidata

result: Gain -0.002 / -0.007 / -0.003; FB 0.385 -> 0.388; external brand data closed

question: Brand momentum, past-only

result: Per-pattern 90% coverage 0.884-0.900; without router 0.46 / 0.56 / 0.83; P(x2) calibrated per pattern, no per-post ranking

question: Facebook on Brand24's own likes / comments

result: X: model 47% of brands within +-50%, rule 2%

question: Can we fetch an external YouTube/X/TikTok sample, and does the model hold on it?

result: Median views 6,697 vs 433; MAE 0.726, bias +0.706 (x5 low); bias-corrected 0.540; slope 0.83; TikTok/X/IG need API or login

question: Can a YouTube sample span small, large and zero-view videos, and how does the model do per stratum?

result: 0 zero-view videos reachable (min 71); model MAE 0.289 on small, 0.620 recent, 0.601 newest, 1.480 popular (x30 low)

question: Can third-party mention videos (not brand channels) be sampled, including tiny/zero-view ones, and does the model hold on them?

result: 1 zero-view, 17 below 100, median 362 (vs 433); MAE 0.690 low, 0.441 mid, 1.569 top; overall 0.791 (bias +0.39)

question: Do the export TikTok views match the public counts today?
setup: Re-read 60 random TikTok posts with headless Chromium; compare playCount with the export
result: 40/60 readable; median ratio 1.068, p90 3.07, 45% within 5%; Spearman 0.918

question: Does the third-party mention result hold on 20 brands?
setup: Same mention collector, 20 brands; 73 videos; model scored externally
result: 73 videos, 4 zero-view, 30 below 100; MAE 0.737, bias +0.42; low/mid/top 0.574/0.581/1.385

question: How stale are the export YouTube views?

result: 58/60; median ratio 1.516, p90 25.3, 19% within 5%; Spearman 0.857

question: Does the mention-population result tighten with 40 brands?
setup: Same mention collector, 40 brands, 144 videos; model scored externally
result: 144 videos, 4 zero, 49 below 100; MAE 0.638, bias +0.35; low/mid/top 0.558/0.553/1.047

question: Do Facebook public view counts move over three days?

result: 60/60 readable; ratio 1.000 on every post (no drift); FB counter is static or cached

question: Does the mention result hold at 60 brands?
setup: Same collector, 60 brands, 203 videos; model scored externally
result: 203 videos, 10 zero, 83 below 100; MAE 0.606, bias +0.28; low/mid/top 0.536/0.555/1.044

question: Can a cheap pay-per-use X sample be fetched, and does the model hold on it?

result: 98 posts for $1.47; median 8 views vs 27; MAE 0.565, bias -0.29 (x2 high); baseline 0.747

question: View range instead of a number

result: 3 ranges acc 0.82 / 0.81 / 0.95 (maj 0.95) / FB 0.80 / IG 0.78; decades 0.74 / 0.60 / 0.58 / 0.64 / 0.56; classifier lower everywhere

question: Why were only 470 of 2,500 Facebook posts attempted?

result: 402 ok, 68 gone, 2,030 have no video id (ordinary posts) - 470 video posts is the complete measurable subset

question: Every training-platform combination
setup: Ridge on likes + comments, 31 training sets, each left-out platform scored; own-platform brand CV reference; equal-weight sensitivity
result: FB / IG x2.4-3.1 from any mix (own x2.4); X hardest x3.6-4.6; X-only training worst; equal weighting worse

question: Instagram transfer on 500 hand-collected reels
setup: X + YouTube ridge on fresh likes + comments; 25-post shift; IG own brand CV; comments-only for hidden likes
result: 338 reels: 0.424 (x2.65) zero-shot, 0.382 (x2.41) after 25 posts, own 0.372 (x2.36); without likes x6-11

question: Cross-domain ideas: post age, brand residual from other platforms

result: Age: FB 0.385 -> 0.406, IG 0.424 -> 0.381 (extrapolated, level shift); brand residual worse everywhere (FB 0.398-0.502, IG 0.440-0.508)

question: Full same-moment re-read of TikTok, YouTube and X
setup: yt-dlp for YouTube, FxTwitter for X (validated against the paid API), logged-in Chromium for the first 500 TikTok posts; resumable, 1 req/s
result: TikTok 426/500, YouTube 2,297/2,500, X 2,013/2,500; views median 1.085 / 1.350 / 2.000, Spearman 0.953 / 0.856 / 0.905; YouTube reactions gap is a yt-dlp extraction issue

question: Does same-moment re-read source data improve the transfer to FB / IG?
setup: Ridge on likes + comments trained on re-read X + YouTube (missing reactions dropped; primary fixed in card) vs export X + YT; fill-0, +TikTok, stacked variants; E201 grid on re-read; paired brand bootstrap
result: IG 0.435 (x2.72) -> 0.382 (x2.41), diff -0.053 (CI -0.087, -0.027), = IG own 0.381; FB 0.385 -> 0.387 (+0.002); top-quintile under-prediction halved; all variants agree

question: Is the E210 gain just post age?
setup: Growth exponent per platform from export/re-read pairs (TikTok 0.18, X 0.25, YouTube 0.56); export labels moved to the re-read age; decomposition on paired posts
result: Views moved: IG 0.402 (0.62 of the gain, CI includes 0), FB 0.485 (+0.100); views + reactions moved together: IG 0.385, FB 0.388; the gain needs views and reactions at the same age

question: Can regression to the mean be undone without losing MAE?
setup: 2SLS (export reactions instrument re-read ones), reliability correction, variance matching; re-read X + YT -> FB / IG and leave-one-platform-out on re-read TikTok / YouTube / X
result: 2SLS / OLS likes slope 0.97: no attenuation; FB 0.389, IG 0.379 (no change); reliability correction worse (+0.08 / +0.04); variance matching fixes totals at +0.01 but hurts TikTok / YouTube (+0.04 / +0.06)

question: Results B re-scored with the re-read source
setup: E210 primary spec; 25-post shift, comments only, own-platform ridge, CQR 90% (E145 protocol, 20 splits)
result: IG x2.41 zero-shot (= own x2.41; 25-post shift no longer helps), FB x2.44 (own x2.42); FB 90% coverage 0.917 at width 1.83, >1M tier 0.836 -> 0.898, <10k 0.845

question: Do synthetic large posts (SMOTER / SMOGN) fix under-prediction of large posts?
setup: Top decile of training y oversampled 1x / 2x (primary) / 5x, SMOGN, + middle undersampling; (a) re-read X + YT ridge -> FB / IG, (b) rt.FINAL in-platform, training folds only
result: 2x: top-tenth bias (true y) -0.10 to -0.15 on IG / YT / X but MAE worse: FB 0.387 -> 0.406, YT 0.456 -> 0.462, X 0.467 -> 0.474 (CIs below 0); top by predicted y turns over-predicted: a stretch, not a gain

question: Do domain randomization and mixup let CatBoost / MLP transfer like ridge?
setup: C2, leave-one-platform-out over TikTok / YT / X + X+YT -> FB / IG; trend-consistent (primary), like-propensity, mixup; CatBoost and MLP 64-64

question: Does a self-supervised code (DAE / SCARF) add signal?
setup: Encoders on 12,500 export + 3,815 re-read rows (no views), 8-dim code; CatBoost ENG + code (brand CV), ridge C2 + code -> FB / IG; transductive and strict
result: DAE in-platform +0.001 / +0.000 / +0.005 (CIs incl. 0); FB 0.385 -> 0.412, IG 0.435 -> 0.439; one non-primary IG hit does not replicate

question: Does self-training on posts without views help?
setup: (a) ridge teacher on re-read X + YT labels FB / IG features, CatBoost student (+ noisy); (b) 634 view-less X posts pseudo-labelled by the fold teacher
result: Best +0.008 (noisy student FB, CI incl. 0); IG -0.002; X 0.467 -> 0.470 (-0.003); teacher error on view-less X 0.658 vs 0.563

question: Do the 505 previously view-less X posts help the X model?
setup: CatBoost (rt.FINAL) on re-read likes / comments / shares + followers + log age, brand CV on 2,013 re-read X posts, trained with vs without the 505; X re-read -> FB / IG ridge
result: Whole stream 0.444 -> 0.440 (diff -0.005 [-0.009, 0.000]); on the 505 -0.014; as source IG 0.438 -> 0.406, FB 0.487 -> 0.520 (CI incl. 0); the 505 add nothing to transfer

question: Are X's zero-like posts what breaks X as source and target?
setup: Ridge on likes + comments; drop zero-like source rows or two-part (zero-like -> source zero-like median); export and re-read X; E201 combinations; zero vs non-zero rows
result: X -> FB -0.036 (CI incl. 0), X -> IG -0.010; X + YT -> FB / IG slightly worse; to export X drop -0.079 but to re-read X -0.014; two-part worse on X targets

question: Can borrowed >1M-follower residuals calibrate the FB >1M band?
setup: E145 CQR protocol (20 splits, 25% of FB brands); >1M pool + 167 re-read TikTok / YouTube / X posts from >=1M accounts, shifted to the FB level; E150 point model on re-read sources
result: FB >1M coverage 0.836 -> 0.883 at 1.18x width (unshifted 0.884, 1.11x); level gap ~0 (+0.30 both); point model no gain (0.410 -> 0.402-0.412)

question: Do authors repeat across platforms with normalised names and handles?
setup: Normalised author names + profile-URL handles over all five platforms incl. FB / IG; gate at 2% of labelled posts; counts only
result: 31 keys on 2+ platforms; 56 of 8,332 labelled posts (0.67%) have a labelled post of the same author elsewhere; gate not passed

question: Headline result on author-safe folds

result: TikTok 0.273 (x1.87), YouTube 0.462 (x2.90), X 0.482 (x3.03); X +0.012 vs brand folds; 90% coverage 0.87-0.91

question: Does the X + YouTube ridge on likes + comments estimate Stack Exchange question views (sixth platform, evaluation only)?
setup: Public SE API, 538 questions Apr-Aug 2026, 48 brands, 10 sites; likes = up votes, comments = answers + comments (fixed before scoring); ridge as results B; reference = same ridge with brand 5-fold CV; E201 grid row
result: MAE 0.498 (x3.14, CI 0.448-0.525), 96% under-predicted, bias +0.45, within x2 28%, Spearman 0.57; own-platform x1.77; ratio 1.77 > 1.5, hypothesis refuted (level shift, rank equal); grid: YouTube x1.87, TikTok x2.41, Instagram x2.46, pooled x3.07, Facebook x3.32, X x4.50

question: Information ladder: what each input buys
setup: Same platform: CatBoost, author-safe folds, median -> followers -> + likes -> + comments -> + shares; out of platform: X + YouTube ridge, median -> comments -> likes -> likes + comments -> fresh source
result: TikTok / YouTube / X x4.6 / 8.8 / 4.6 -> followers x3.8 / 6.0 / 3.9 -> + likes x1.9 / 3.2 / 3.0 -> final x1.9 / 2.9 / 3.0; FB / IG median x19.9 / 8.7, comments only x7.4 / 6.3, likes only x2.5 / 2.7, fresh source x2.4 / 2.4; FB export reactions x6.8

question: Red-team baselines: likes multiplier, median skill, paired CIs
setup: Likes multiplier (views = k x likes) and median vs CatBoost (same platform, author-safe folds) and vs the X + YouTube ridge (FB, IG, Stack Exchange); paired brand bootstrap
result: Same platform CatBoost beats the multiplier by 0.08-0.15; out of platform FB ridge = multiplier = own model (x2.42-2.43), IG ridge x2.72 vs multiplier x2.94 and own x2.41 (+0.054, CI 0.021-0.093); Stack Exchange transfer worse than the median (skill -0.71) (transfer = calibrated views-per-like ratio; "as good as own platform" only on FB; ridge vs multiplier with export-only sources: better on TT / IG / SE, tie on FB, slightly worse on YT (+0.007), worse on X (+0.116); Stack Exchange in the E201 grid: x1.87 from YouTube alone, x3-5 from any set with X, own x1.77)

question: Result without extreme posts, as classification, as probability
setup: Final CatBoost predictions (same platform); error without bottom / top 20% cut by true views vs by the estimate; three ranges; AUC for top / bottom 20%
result: Oracle middle 60% x1.69 / x2.43 / x2.29, by the estimate x1.77 / x2.95 / x2.93 (all x1.87 / x2.90 / x3.03); ranges balanced accuracy 0.77 / 0.72 / 0.43 (X accuracy 0.95 = majority); AUC large post 0.97 / 0.92 / 0.84; without posts with <= 5 reactions x1.81 / x2.29 / x2.56 (83 / 54 / 10% kept)

question: Instagram owner followers
setup: Followers of 539 reel owners (public profiles); ridge transfer from export X + YT with / without log followers; own IG ridge, CV by owner and by brand
result: Transfer x2.72 -> x4.58 with followers (+0.227, CI 0.155-0.294); own IG x2.40 -> x2.23 (-0.032, CI -0.038 to -0.025); followers alone x3.62

question: Transfer with more fields
setup: Leave one export platform out + FB / IG from X + YT; likes + comments vs + shares / followers / all 8 fields, imputed or dropped; ridge and CatBoost
result: No set helps everywhere: TT worse with every extra field (+0.03 to +0.12), YT all fields -0.023, X followers + likes -0.068, FB + shares +0.002, IG + followers ridge +0.227 / CatBoost -0.009 (CI incl. 0)

question: Confidence model
setup: Second CatBoost predicts each post's absolute error (or P within x2) from its fields + the estimate, out-of-fold; risk-coverage vs reactions rule and oracle
result: Weak: AUC 'error > x2' 0.54 / 0.62 / 0.53; most trusted 80% x1.83 / x2.62 / x2.92 vs all x1.87 / x2.90 / x3.03; reactions rule as good on YT; P >= 0.8 covers 8% / 2% / 0.4% and is overconfident

question: Viral and outlier posts without views
setup: Top 10% of views flagged from reactions and followers (export platforms leave-one-out, FB / IG from X + YT); over / under-performers vs the final model from followers, text, time
result: Viral: AUC 0.98 / 0.88 / 0.86 (TT / YT / X), FB 0.94, IG 0.98, raw likes as good; outliers not predictable (AUC 0.53-0.65, YT under-performers 0.76 = zero reactions); first run inflated by age

question: Are view-model outliers off-brand mentions, and can the detector reach AUC 0.75?
setup: Top and bottom 5% of the final residual vs the E224 score (TikTok / YouTube / X); 9 methods (stack, name ambiguity, Louvain grid, author level, text features, label propagation, calibration) in brand-grouped CV on 287 AI labels
result: Outliers not more off-brand: AUC of the score 0.47 (over 0.45, under 0.50); flagging the top 5% removes 2.3% of the views, over-performer rate stays 5%. Detector: best stack + text features 0.766 (0.701-0.823), lower bound below 0.75 and 14 variants tried, so not confirmed; graph grid 0.731, all features 0.747, others 0.34-0.69

question: Spikes of small accounts
setup: Views >= 30x what an account of that size usually gets, found from likes per follower without views; own-history baseline checked where possible
result: Spike AUC 0.98 / 0.86 / 0.89 (TT / YT / X), precision top 5% 0.78 / 0.51 / 0.36; TikTok: 23 small accounts with ~600 usual views and ~185k, 96% flagged; own-history test impossible (1-5 spikes)

question: Other linear models than ridge
setup: OLS, lasso, elastic net, Huber and median regression on likes + comments; leave one export platform out and FB / IG from X + YT; paired brand-bootstrap vs ridge
result: Penalty irrelevant (OLS = ridge, lasso / elastic net within 0.006); Huber / median help only on X (x4.47 to x3.96-3.98, -0.05) and hurt TikTok / Instagram (+0.02-0.03)

question: Ridge in and out of platform, export vs re-read
setup: One grid: ridge on likes + comments in platform (brand CV) and out of platform, export labels and same-moment re-read labels
result: Re-read: out of platform x2.14 / x3.01 vs in platform x2.10 / x2.96 (YT / X); export gap on X (x4.47 vs x3.30) mostly stale views; TikTok exception (426 posts)

question: Text analysis per platform
setup: Length, language, hashtags, links, emoji, duplicates, AI type and sentiment labels, distinctive words, median views by type; 5 platforms x 2,500
result: FB 85% / IG 59% promo, X 68% organic; hashtags IG 96% vs X 20%; links YT 51%; X negative 22%; FB almost no emoji (data artefact?)

question: Are the export X views or our read wrong, and are YouTube zero likes real?
setup: 50 X posts compared across export, FxTwitter and the paid API; 20 YouTube posts with export likes=0 re-read from the public page
result: FxTwitter vs paid 98% identical (ratio 1.000, rho 1.000); export vs paid ratio 1.792, rho 0.926; 10/20 YouTube zeros are positive likes, 6 true zeros, 4 unknown

question: Do our FB / IG post owners have the same account on YouTube or X?
setup: Public pages only, strong evidence required (bio link, or same handle + same name + cross-link or badge); 246 owners behind 1,098 scored posts; YouTube search + about tab, X via FxTwitter; salted-hash storage, counts only
result: 181 FB author URLs are numeric page ids, so 65 IG owners were checkable; 11 of 65 matched on YouTube (all bio_link), 0 on X (no public profile API); 17 scored posts covered (1.55%), gate 40 not passed, verdict provisional for FB

question: Is a mention really about its brand?
setup: Four views-free detectors on all 12,500 mentions: lexical name / handle match, e5 leave-self-out centroid z, TF-IDF + e5 10-NN graphs + Louvain against the brand base rate, one-vs-rest brand classifier; rank average; 300-post blind sample by combined-score decile (ambiguous names x3, all 5 platforms), 3 blind AI passes + adjudication
result: AUC for not_about_brand (n=287, 221 positives): lexical 0.475, embedding 0.616, graph TF-IDF 0.670, graph e5 0.693, graph 0.702, classifier 0.665, **combined 0.677 (0.589-0.763; design-weighted 0.717) - below the pre-registered 0.75, hypothesis refuted**; Fleiss kappa 0.811; precision 0.784 in the top 5% and 0.844 in the top 10% of the combined score; design-weighted off-brand share 64.3% (55.8-72.6) under the "brand is the subject" definition, 6.7% when the brand string is not in the text at all; model MAE 0.385 on the top-5% posts vs 0.398 elsewhere, 0.418 (not_about_brand) vs 0.380 (about_brand); dropping the top 5% removes 5% of all views, Cricket Wireless loses 50.7% of its views
